name: task_agent_composition

test_list.description: Reject absent authority transport, changed schema pin or mismatched calibration before model execution.
Bind actual capabilities, leases, S1, mutation receipts, sandbox approval and independent proof.
Cancel the control service and close model/kernel owners before returning.
Recover an explicit environment/keyring key without persisting or exposing plaintext key values.
Profiles without agent policy retain their original read authority and proof distinction.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: Explicit host-owned runtime paths, authority policy, schema pins, sandbox policy and optional private checkpoint key reference.

output_description: Actual driver and separate proof status. Implementation verification deferred by user instruction.
